 FOR SUBSCRIBERS Health news Will daylight saving time ever become permanent? Health experts hope not
 Clocks turn back an hour this weekend. A new study warns that year-round daylight saving time would mean millions more dark school commutes, with greater risk of deadly crashes. Listen to this article 00:00 00:00 Daylight saving time ends early Sunday, when clocks will turn back an hour. Kinga Krzeminska / Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 30, 2026, 12:10 PM EDT By Aria Bendix Love it or hate it, clocks will turn back an hour at 2 a.m. on Sunday, shifting sunrises and sunsets earlier as we return to standard time. Just as reliable as the twice-annual clock change is the debate about whether it’s helpful or detrimental to our health and economy.
